promiscuous.label: Promiscuous
promiscuous.description: Comfortable with casual intimacy; fewer emotional prerequisites, open to multiple partners.

flirtatious.label: Flirtatious
flirtatious.description: Enjoys flirting and light sexual tension; doesn't always intend follow-through.

sexually_confident.label: Sexually Confident
sexually_confident.description: Comfortable with their sexuality; expresses desires clearly, no performance anxiety.

sexually_insecure.label: Sexually Insecure
sexually_insecure.description: Anxious about intimacy; may deflect advances even when interested, fears rejection.

demisexual.label: Demisexual
demisexual.description: Sexual attraction only activates after forming a strong emotional bond.

romantic.label: Romantic
romantic.description: Values emotional intimacy and romantic connection deeply; prefers meaningful encounters.

exercise_overdoer.label: Overdoer
exercise_overdoer.description: Goes all-out every session — rapid gains but high injury risk and long recovery gaps.

exercise_consistent.label: Consistent Trainer
exercise_consistent.description: Builds sustainable routines, rarely skips, rarely gets hurt. Slow and steady wins.

exercise_social_only.label: Social Exerciser
exercise_social_only.description: Goes reluctantly alone; needs a workout buddy. Full benefit only with a companion.

high_self_control.label: High Self-Control
high_self_control.description: Rarely acts on impulse; can endure significant frustration before lashing out.

low_self_control.label: Low Self-Control
low_self_control.description: Struggles to suppress impulses; minor provocations can spiral quickly.

hot_tempered.label: Hot-Tempered
hot_tempered.description: Short fuse — anger spikes fast but may also cool quickly.

sexist.label: Sexist
sexist.description: Holds derogatory attitudes toward women; more likely to direct aggression at female targets.

egalitarian.label: Egalitarian
egalitarian.description: Treats all genders equitably; sexism_level near zero.

controlling_partner.label: Controlling Partner
controlling_partner.description: Uses psychological pressure, jealousy, and isolation to dominate intimate partners.

domestic_abuser.label: Domestic Abuser
domestic_abuser.description: Directs violence preferentially at intimate partners; uses shame, threats, and physical force to maintain control.

low_self_esteem.label: Low Self-Esteem
low_self_esteem.description: Prone to self-doubt; more vulnerable to negging and psychological manipulation.

codependent.label: Codependent
codependent.description: Ties self-worth to the relationship; tolerates mistreatment to avoid abandonment.

authority_abuser.label: Authority Abuser
authority_abuser.description: Exploits institutional position (police, boss, doctor) to control and conceal abuse. Reports are less believed; victim faces retaliatory consequences.

power_gatekeeper.label: Power Gatekeeper
power_gatekeeper.description: Controls career opportunities, contacts, or resources others depend on. Uses this leverage for coercive quid-pro-quo arrangements.

career_ambitious.label: Career Ambitious
career_ambitious.description: Strongly motivated by professional advancement; vulnerable to quid-pro-quo pressure from gatekeepers.

emotionally_controlling.label: Emotionally Controlling
emotionally_controlling.description: Uses psychological tactics — emasculation, ridicule, abandonment threats, affair humiliation — to dominate and diminish a partner.

financial_dominator.label: Financial Dominator
financial_dominator.description: Ensures they always out-earn the partner; uses financial superiority as leverage.

emasculator.label: Emasculator
emasculator.description: Systematically attacks a male partner's sense of masculinity, competence, and attractiveness.

deeply_religious.name: Deeply Religious
deeply_religious.description: Strong religious faith shapes worldview, morality, and relationships.

sex_negative.name: Sex-Negative
sex_negative.description: Believes sex is shameful or only acceptable for reproduction within marriage.

homophobic.name: Homophobic
homophobic.description: Holds strongly negative views toward homosexuality and LGBT+ identities.

sexually_repressed.name: Sexually Repressed
sexually_repressed.description: Sexual desires suppressed by shame or religious upbringing; affects intimacy.

sexual_shame.name: Sexual Shame
sexual_shame.description: Experiences intense guilt or shame around sexuality and intimate desires.

self_destructive.name: Self-Destructive
self_destructive.description: Prone to behaviour that causes harm to oneself, often as a coping mechanism.

addiction_prone.name: Addiction-Prone
addiction_prone.description: Susceptible to dependency on substances or compulsive behaviours under stress.

identity_crisis_prone.name: Identity Crisis-Prone
identity_crisis_prone.description: Struggles with a coherent sense of self; vulnerable to existential destabilisation.

sexually_shy.description: Becomes flustered and avoidant when sexuality or romance is raised; blushes easily and struggles to reciprocate flirting.

easily_embarrassed.description: Flushes and becomes visibly flustered at mildly awkward or suggestive topics, even non-sexual ones.

asexual_tendency.description: Little or no spontaneous sexual attraction; may engage for emotional closeness but rarely initiates. Distinct from low_libido — the motivation is absent, not just the drive.

sexually_brazen.description: Openly discusses and pursues sex without embarrassment; rarely blushes, comfortable making explicit suggestions.

daydreamer.description: Frequently lost in fantasy and imagination; prone to vivid romantic or sexual daydreams about specific people.

infatuation_prone.description: Develops intense crushes quickly; fixates on a person and fantasizes about them at length, often out of proportion to actual closeness.

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.description: Emergency care, surgery, long-term stays. Sims visit when health_state includes a medical emergency.

gp_clinic.name: GP / Doctor's Clinic
gp_clinic.description: Routine checkups, prescriptions, managing chronic conditions.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: Buy medicine items. Sim selects from item_templates where category='medicine'.

clothing_store.name: Clothing Store
clothing_store.description: Buy clothing items. Sim selects from item_templates where category='clothing'.

shoe_store.name: Shoe Store
shoe_store.description: Shoes and footwear. Filters item_templates to slot='feet'.

department_store.name: Department Store
department_store.description: Large store with all clothing slots. Full item_templates category='clothing' selection.

thrift_store.name: Thrift / Second-Hand Store
thrift_store.description: Cheap second-hand clothing. Prices at 25% of base_price.

retail_store.name: General Retail Store
retail_store.description: General shop. Items from any item_template category.

grocery_store.name: Grocery Store / Supermarket
grocery_store.description: Food and drink items. Sim selects from item_templates where category in ('food','drink','groceries').

electronics_store.name: Electronics Store
electronics_store.description: Electronics, phones, computers. Filters item_templates where category='electronics'.

furniture_store.name: Furniture Store
furniture_store.description: Props and furniture for homes. Sim browses prop_templates.

cafe.name: Café
cafe.description: Coffee, tea, light snacks. Reduces hunger/thirst, boosts energy/mood.

restaurant.name: Restaurant
restaurant.description: Full meals. Often visited with other characters for a social dining event.

bar.name: Bar / Pub
bar.description: Socializing and drinking. Sober score decays; intoxication may occur.

tech_company.name: Tech Company
tech_company.description: Employer — sims with tech jobs work here off-screen.

school.name: School / University
school.description: Children attend school. Adults may take evening classes.

gym.name: Gym / Fitness Center
gym.description: Working out. Improves fitness, burns energy.

spa.name: Spa / Wellness Center
spa.description: Massages, facials, relaxation. Strongly reduces stress.

construction_co.name: Construction Company
construction_co.description: Employer. Also supplies hired construction/renovation services.

cleaning_co.name: Cleaning Company
cleaning_co.description: Provides hired cleaning services to households.

barbershop.name: Barbershop
barbershop.description: Characters visit off-grid to get a haircut or styling. Sim selects a hairstyle (item with category='hair') and pays. Returns with updated current_hairstyle.

hair_salon.name: Hair Salon
hair_salon.description: Upscale hair services. Wider style selection than a barbershop.

obstetrics_clinic.name: Obstetrics & Prenatal Clinic
obstetrics_clinic.description: Specialist prenatal care: routine check-ups, ultrasounds, and delivery planning.

maternity_ward.name: Maternity Ward
maternity_ward.description: In-patient childbirth and post-natal recovery unit.

kindergarten.name: Kindergarten
kindergarten.description: Daycare and early education for children age 1–3 before preschool.

therapist.name: Therapist
therapist.description: Talk therapy -- individual, couples, and crisis sessions.

online_retailer.name: Online Retailer
online_retailer.description: No storefront -- orders and support are handled online or by phone/email.

socialize.name: Socialise
socialize.description: Spend quality time with other people — friends, neighbours, or family.

nature.name: Time in Nature
nature.description: Spend time outdoors, in parks, gardens, or natural surroundings.

exercise.name: Physical Exercise
exercise.description: Engage in physical activity — gym, running, sports, or home workout.

creative.name: Creative Outlet
creative.description: Engage in a creative activity — art, music, writing, cooking, or crafting.

romance.name: Romance
romance.description: Seek or maintain a romantic relationship — quality one-on-one time with a partner, dating, or pursuing new connections.

intimacy.name: Intimacy
intimacy.description: Physical and emotional closeness with a partner or romantic interest.

learning.name: Learning
learning.description: Stimulate the mind by acquiring new knowledge or skills.

solitude.name: Solitude
solitude.description: Spend meaningful alone time to recharge and reflect.

spirituality.name: Spirituality
spirituality.description: Practice faith, meditation, or personal philosophy.

purpose.name: Sense of Purpose
purpose.description: Engage in work, volunteering, or projects that feel meaningful.

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.description: Seek new experiences, travel, or excitement beyond daily routine.

play.name: Play
play.description: Engage in games, fun activities, or lighthearted entertainment.

content.name: Content
content.description: A baseline state of satisfaction and ease.

cheerful.name: Cheerful
cheerful.description: Upbeat and positive — prone to jokes and warmth.

playful.name: Playful
playful.description: Energetic and fun-seeking. Low threshold for goofing off.

focused.name: Focused
focused.description: Calm and productive. Less interested in socialising.

romantic.name: Romantic
romantic.description: Emotionally open, seeking connection and affection.

restless.name: Restless
restless.description: Cannot settle. Seeking stimulation or change.

lonely.name: Lonely
lonely.description: Craving company and connection. May reach out or withdraw.

anxious.name: Anxious
anxious.description: On edge. Overanalyses, second-guesses, may avoid social situations.

sad.name: Sad
sad.description: Low energy and emotional flatness. May cry or withdraw.

grieving.name: Grieving
grieving.description: Intense emotional pain following loss. Needs support.

depressed.name: Depressed
depressed.description: Persistent low mood. Neglects hygiene, skips meals, avoids people.

furious.name: Furious
furious.description: Explosive anger. May say things they regret.

embarrassed.name: Embarrassed
embarrassed.description: Self-conscious and flustered. Wants to avoid the source of embarrassment.

energized.name: Energized
energized.description: Rested and ready. More initiative, more productive.

default_item_interactions.label: Drop
default_item_interactions.note: Places item on the ground at character's current position

default_item_interactions.label: Place / Put In
default_item_interactions.note: isSurface=true props render items on top; others hide them inside

headache.name: Headache
headache.description: Persistent pain in the head ranging from dull pressure to sharp throbbing

consequences.short: Reduced concentration, irritability, sensitivity to light and sound
consequences.medium_long: Chronic headaches can indicate hypertension, eye strain, or neurological deterioration
consequences.long: Severe untreated headaches may signal a stroke, aneurysm, or brain tumour — risk of permanent neurological damage

chest_pain.name: Chest Pain
chest_pain.description: Tightness, pressure or sharp pain in the chest, often radiating to the left arm or jaw

consequences.short: Difficulty breathing, anxiety, avoidance of physical exertion
consequences.medium_long: Repeated episodes indicate worsening cardiac function; risk of arrhythmia increases
consequences.long: Untreated leads to myocardial infarction (heart attack), cardiac arrest, or death

shortness_of_breath.name: Shortness of Breath
shortness_of_breath.description: Inability to catch breath, laboured breathing, feeling of suffocation

consequences.short: Cannot exert physically, panic attacks, reduced mobility
consequences.medium_long: Oxygen deprivation affects organ function; worsens cardiac and pulmonary conditions
consequences.long: Respiratory failure, hypoxic organ damage, cardiac arrest if untreated

sweating.name: Profuse Sweating
sweating.description: Uncontrolled excessive sweating unrelated to heat or exertion

consequences.short: Discomfort, social embarrassment, dehydration
consequences.medium_long: Electrolyte imbalance; signals autonomic nervous system dysfunction
consequences.long: Severe dehydration leading to fainting or organ stress; underlying cardiac crisis

low_energy.name: Chronic Fatigue
low_energy.description: Persistent exhaustion not relieved by rest, affecting all daily activities

consequences.short: Inability to work or perform tasks, prolonged sleep, apathy
consequences.medium_long: Muscle atrophy, immune suppression, depression worsens
consequences.long: Complete functional decline; organ systems begin to fail from chronic under-oxygenation

nausea.name: Nausea
nausea.description: Persistent urge to vomit, stomach unease, loss of appetite

consequences.short: Unable to eat, dehydration, weight loss
consequences.medium_long: Malnutrition, electrolyte imbalance, weakened immune system
consequences.long: Severe dehydration leading to kidney damage or fainting; indicator of systemic organ distress

mood_swings.name: Mood Swings
mood_swings.description: Rapid unpredictable shifts between emotional states — anger, sadness, elation

consequences.short: Relationship strain, impulsive decisions, aggressive outbursts
consequences.medium_long: Social isolation, job loss, compounding mental health decline
consequences.long: Chronic psychiatric deterioration; increased risk of self-harm or harming others

consequences.short: Bed confinement, dehydration, inability to work
consequences.medium_long: Febrile seizures possible; sustained high fever causes protein denaturation
consequences.long: Brain damage from extreme fever (>41°C); septic shock if infection is the root cause

coughing.name: Coughing
coughing.description: Persistent cough, may be dry or productive with phlegm

consequences.short: Sleep disruption, sore throat, social exclusion (contagion concern)
consequences.medium_long: Damaged airway lining, increased infection risk, vocal cord strain
consequences.long: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease if unresolved; haemoptysis (coughing blood) indicates serious lung condition

consequences.short: Discomfort, reduced smell/taste, disrupted sleep
consequences.medium_long: Sinus infection if bacteria enter inflamed sinuses
consequences.long: Chronic sinusitis causing persistent pain and reduced quality of life

fatigue.name: Fatigue
fatigue.description: Moderate tiredness and reduced stamina, distinct from chronic fatigue

consequences.short: Slowed reactions, reduced productivity, increased accident risk
consequences.medium_long: Immune suppression, hormonal disruption
consequences.long: Progression to chronic fatigue syndrome; cardiovascular stress from sustained overexertion

dizziness.name: Dizziness / Vertigo
dizziness.description: Sensation of spinning or loss of balance; lightheadedness

consequences.short: Falls, nausea, inability to drive or operate machinery
consequences.medium_long: Recurring falls cause physical injury; underlying inner ear or cardiovascular issue worsens
consequences.long: Fainting (syncope); if cardiac-related, risk of sudden cardiac arrest

vision_blur.name: Blurred Vision
vision_blur.description: Reduced visual clarity, halos around lights, double vision

consequences.short: Danger when driving or operating machinery; headaches
consequences.medium_long: Permanent vision degradation if underlying condition untreated
consequences.long: Complete vision loss; if stroke-related, indicates major neurological event in progress

joint_pain.name: Joint Pain
joint_pain.description: Aching, swelling or stiffness in one or more joints

consequences.short: Reduced mobility, difficulty with physical tasks
consequences.medium_long: Cartilage degradation, muscle atrophy around affected joints
consequences.long: Permanent joint deformity; if from Borrelia or autoimmune source, systemic organ involvement

abdominal_pain.name: Abdominal Pain
abdominal_pain.description: Cramping, stabbing, or aching pain in the stomach or intestinal region

consequences.short: Inability to eat or move comfortably, diarrhoea or constipation
consequences.medium_long: Intestinal inflammation, malabsorption of nutrients
consequences.long: Intestinal perforation leading to peritonitis and internal bleeding; sepsis

convulsions.name: Convulsions / Seizures
convulsions.description: Uncontrolled rhythmic muscle contractions, loss of consciousness during episode

consequences.short: Physical injury during seizure (head impact, biting tongue), incontinence, post-ictal confusion
consequences.medium_long: Brain micro-damage accumulates with repeated seizures; social functioning severely impaired
consequences.long: Status epilepticus (prolonged seizure) causing permanent brain damage or death

rash.name: Skin Rash
rash.description: Red, itchy, or painful skin eruption — may be localised or widespread

consequences.short: Itching, pain, social embarrassment
consequences.medium_long: Secondary bacterial infection from scratching; scarring
consequences.long: Systemic allergic response (anaphylaxis) if allergen not removed; organ involvement in autoimmune rashes

internal_bleeding.name: Internal Bleeding
internal_bleeding.description: Blood accumulating inside the body cavity — not visible externally

consequences.short: Abdominal rigidity, dropping blood pressure, shock
consequences.medium_long: Organ compression and failure from haematoma expansion
consequences.long: Death from haemorrhagic shock if not surgically treated within hours

numbness.name: Numbness / Tingling
numbness.description: Loss of sensation or pins-and-needles in extremities or face

consequences.short: Loss of fine motor control, increased injury risk (cannot feel pain signals)
consequences.medium_long: Muscle wasting in affected area from disuse; nerve pathway degradation
consequences.long: Permanent paralysis of affected limb if nerve supply is severed or chronically compressed; if facial — stroke indicator

speech_difficulty.name: Speech Difficulty
speech_difficulty.description: Slurred, garbled or lost speech; inability to find words

consequences.short: Cannot communicate needs; social panic
consequences.medium_long: Isolation, depression, loss of autonomy
consequences.long: Permanent aphasia following stroke; cognitive decline from untreated neurological damage

common_cold.name: Common Cold
common_cold.description: Viral upper respiratory infection causing nasal congestion, sore throat and fatigue
common_cold.notes: Self-resolving in 5-10 days. Rest and fluids are primary treatment.

influenza.name: Influenza (Flu)
influenza.description: Acute viral infection with high fever, body aches, and respiratory symptoms
influenza.notes: Can be severe or fatal in elderly and immunocompromised individuals.

coronavirus.name: Coronavirus (COVID-19)
coronavirus.description: SARS-CoV-2 respiratory infection ranging from mild to life-threatening
coronavirus.notes: Risk of 'long COVID' with lasting fatigue and breathing issues. Elderly/obese individuals at higher risk of hospitalisation.

heart_disease_low.name: Heart Disease (Mild)
heart_disease_low.description: Early-stage coronary artery disease with reduced blood flow; manageable with medication and lifestyle changes
heart_disease_low.notes: Medication compliance critical. Poor diet or stress can accelerate to medium severity.

heart_disease_medium.name: Heart Disease (Moderate)
heart_disease_medium.description: Significant coronary artery disease with noticeable exercise limitation and risk of cardiac events
heart_disease_medium.notes: 50% chance of eventually needing bypass or stent surgery. Stamina noticeably reduced. Stress and exertion can trigger cardiac events.

heart_disease_high.name: Heart Disease (Severe)
heart_disease_high.description: Critical cardiac condition. Surgery is needed as soon as possible. Every day without intervention makes symptoms worse and increases risk of heart attack.
heart_disease_high.notes: Each day without surgery: symptoms intensify (sweating, chest pain, anger, nausea), collapse risk rises. Without intervention will eventually trigger heart attack or unconscious collapse.

cancer_low.name: Cancer (Early Stage)
cancer_low.description: Localised tumour detected early; high chance of full remission with treatment
cancer_low.notes: Early detection is key. Regular monitoring required. Chemotherapy causes fatigue and nausea as side effects.

cancer_medium.name: Cancer (Intermediate Stage)
cancer_medium.description: Cancer has spread to nearby tissue or lymph nodes; intensive treatment required
cancer_medium.notes: 5-year survival rates vary by cancer type. Treatment side effects substantially reduce quality of life.

cancer_high.name: Cancer (Advanced / Terminal)
cancer_high.description: Metastatic cancer spread to multiple organs. Curative treatment no longer viable; palliative care focus.
cancer_high.notes: Terminal prognosis. Goal shifts to pain management and quality of remaining life. Rapid physical decline expected.

epilepsy.name: Epilepsy
epilepsy.description: Neurological disorder causing recurrent seizures of varying severity
epilepsy.notes: With medication, most patients lead normal lives. Seizures can cause injury. Cannot drive. Stress and sleep deprivation increase seizure frequency.

aggressive_gut_bacteria.name: Aggressive Gut Bacteria (C. diff / H. pylori)
aggressive_gut_bacteria.description: Pathogenic bacterial infection of the gastrointestinal tract causing severe cramping and diarrhoea
aggressive_gut_bacteria.notes: Contagious through faecal-oral route. Antibiotic treatment usually effective. Risk of recurrence.

ibs.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
ibs.description: Chronic gastrointestinal disorder causing alternating constipation, diarrhoea, bloating and pain
ibs.notes: Triggered by stress, diet, and hormones. Diet management reduces flare-ups. Significantly impacts daily quality of life.

low_vision.name: Low Vision
low_vision.description: Significantly reduced visual acuity not fully correctable with standard glasses or lenses
low_vision.notes: Glasses or contact lenses may partially compensate. Laser surgery may correct some cases. Affects ability to drive and recognise faces.

low_hearing.name: Hearing Loss
low_hearing.description: Partial or severe reduction in ability to hear, affecting one or both ears
low_hearing.notes: Hearing aids can compensate significantly. Social isolation risk without treatment. May affect speech clarity over time.

handicap.name: Physical Handicap
handicap.description: Loss of function in a body part — may be from injury, birth defect, or disease
handicap.notes: Nature of handicap depends on affected body part and usability. Prosthetics or assistive devices can restore partial function.

low_liver_function.name: Reduced Liver Function (Cirrhosis / Hepatic Insufficiency)
low_liver_function.description: Liver unable to adequately filter toxins, metabolise medications, or produce essential proteins
low_liver_function.notes: Alcohol massively accelerates deterioration. Medication doses must be adjusted. Risk of hepatic coma in severe cases.

borrelia.name: Borrelia / Lyme Disease
borrelia.description: Tick-borne bacterial infection. Curable if caught early; becomes chronic and debilitating if untreated
borrelia.notes: Bull's-eye rash is diagnostic. Early antibiotic treatment is curative. Late-stage becomes chronic with neurological and joint damage.

impotency.name: Erectile Dysfunction / Impotency
impotency.description: Inability to achieve or maintain erection sufficient for sexual intercourse
impotency.notes: Often psychological or vascular in origin. Treatable with medication. May indicate underlying cardiovascular disease.

sterility.name: Sterility / Infertility
sterility.description: Inability to reproduce. May affect either sex.
sterility.notes: No direct health impact. IVF or adoption are alternatives for parenthood. Significant emotional and relationship impact.

nerve_damage.name: Peripheral Nerve Damage (Neuropathy)
nerve_damage.description: Damage to peripheral nerves causing pain, numbness, or weakness in affected areas
nerve_damage.notes: Caused by diabetes, alcohol, trauma or infection. Loss of protective pain sensation increases injury risk.

allergy_severe.name: Severe Allergy (Anaphylaxis Risk)
allergy_severe.description: Hypersensitivity to specific allergen with risk of life-threatening anaphylactic reaction
allergy_severe.notes: Always carry epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen). Exposure must be strictly avoided. Anaphylaxis is a fatal emergency without treatment.

std_chlamydia.name: Chlamydia (STI)
std_chlamydia.description: Common bacterial sexually transmitted infection, often asymptomatic
std_chlamydia.notes: Easily curable with antibiotics. Untreated: can cause pelvic inflammatory disease and infertility.

std_gonorrhea.name: Gonorrhoea (STI)
std_gonorrhea.description: Bacterial sexually transmitted infection causing painful urination and discharge
std_gonorrhea.notes: Antibiotic-resistant strains emerging. Must treat sexual partners simultaneously.

std_herpes.name: Herpes (HSV-1/HSV-2)
std_herpes.description: Viral STI causing recurring painful blisters on genitals or mouth; no cure
std_herpes.notes: Managed with antiviral suppression therapy. Highly contagious during outbreaks. Significant social stigma.

std_hiv.name: HIV / AIDS
std_hiv.description: Viral infection attacking the immune system. Without treatment progresses to AIDS.
std_hiv.notes: Modern ART (antiretroviral therapy) allows near-normal lifespan. Without treatment: immune collapse within years. Undetectable = uninfectious.

std_syphilis.name: Syphilis (STI)
std_syphilis.description: Bacterial STI progressing through distinct stages; can affect brain and heart if untreated
std_syphilis.notes: Penicillin is curative. Late-stage (tertiary) syphilis causes cardiovascular and neurological damage — not fully reversible.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.description: Traumatic brain injury from head impact — confusion, headache, sensitivity to light, short-term memory issues
concussion.notes: No screens, no alcohol, no strenuous activity. Multiple concussions greatly increase risk of CTE (chronic traumatic encephalopathy) — apply cumulative mental trait risk.

depression.name: Clinical Depression
depression.description: Persistent low mood, loss of interest in activities, hopelessness and low self-worth lasting more than two weeks
depression.notes: Can be triggered by strokes, chronic illness, life events. Medication and therapy required. Suicide risk elevated.

anxiety_disorder.name: Generalised Anxiety Disorder
anxiety_disorder.description: Persistent and excessive worry about everyday events, often with physical tension and restlessness
anxiety_disorder.notes: Avoidance behaviours worsen over time. Cognitive behavioural therapy alongside medication is most effective.

ptsd.name: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
ptsd.description: Flashbacks, nightmares and hypervigilance following severe trauma
ptsd.notes: Triggered by head impacts, violent events, or severe psychological trauma. Nightmares disrupt sleep causing fatigue cascade.

bipolar_disorder.name: Bipolar Disorder
bipolar_disorder.description: Cyclic episodes of mania (euphoria, reckless behaviour) and depression
bipolar_disorder.notes: Mania phase: impulsive spending, sexual recklessness, reduced sleep need. Depression phase: severe withdrawal. Medication critical.

ocd.name: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
ocd.description: Intrusive obsessive thoughts driving repetitive compulsive behaviours
ocd.notes: Rituals consume large amounts of time. Anxiety spikes if unable to complete compulsions. Interferes with social and work life.

schizophrenia.name: Schizophrenia
schizophrenia.description: Severe psychotic disorder with hallucinations, delusions and disorganised thought
schizophrenia.notes: Hallucinations and paranoia can make character behave erratically and dangerously. Without medication: episodes of psychosis become more severe.

dementia.name: Dementia / Alzheimer's
dementia.description: Progressive neurological decline — memory loss, confusion, personality changes
dementia.notes: Accumulates via strokes or ageing. Eventually cannot care for self. Wandering, aggression, forgetting family members.

adhd.name: ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder)
adhd.description: Difficulty sustaining attention, impulsivity, and excessive activity beyond normal variation
adhd.notes: Reduced task completion efficiency. Impulsive decisions increase risk-taking. Medication significantly improves focus.

panic_disorder.name: Panic Disorder
panic_disorder.description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with racing heart, dizziness and terror of dying
panic_disorder.notes: Panic attacks mimic heart attacks — cause significant ER visits. Agoraphobia often develops as avoidance behaviour.

paranoid_personality.name: Paranoid Personality Disorder
paranoid_personality.description: Pervasive distrust and suspicion of others; interprets benign actions as malicious
paranoid_personality.notes: Cannot form close relationships. Hostile to helpers. Refuses medication believing it is harmful. Can emerge from stroke or head trauma.

antisocial_personality.name: Antisocial Personality Disorder
antisocial_personality.description: Disregard for others' rights; manipulative, deceitful, impulsive and often aggressive
antisocial_personality.notes: Increased aggression and social conflict. Can lead to violent acts. Head impacts a major trigger. No effective medication.

borderline_personality.name: Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
borderline_personality.description: Emotional dysregulation, unstable relationships, self-harm risk and fear of abandonment
borderline_personality.notes: Extreme mood swings in response to perceived slights. Relationships intensely unstable. Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) is primary treatment.

sexual_repression_disorder.label: Sexual Repression Disorder
sexual_repression_disorder.description: Chronic inability to accept or express sexuality; rooted in shame or conditioning.

identity_crisis.label: Identity Crisis
identity_crisis.description: Profound conflict between inner identity (often LGBT+) and external expectations.

extra_toe.name: Extra Toe
extra_toe.description: Has an extra toe on one foot.

underweight.name: Underweight
underweight.description: Notably below a healthy body weight.

asexual.name: Asexual
asexual.description: Experiences little to no sexual attraction.

sensitive_stomach.name: Sensitive Stomach
sensitive_stomach.description: Prone to digestive upset from rich or unfamiliar food.

high_stamina.name: High Stamina
high_stamina.description: Can sustain physical activity for long periods.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.description: Struggles to fall or stay asleep.

extra_teeth.name: Extra Teeth
extra_teeth.description: Has one or more supernumerary teeth.

incontinent.name: Incontinent
incontinent.description: Has difficulty controlling bladder or bowels.

proposal_response_schema._comment: Used when initiation_type is suggestion_proposal. The target may respond in one of these ways.

approve.description: Accept the proposal. Interaction proceeds as requested.

counter_proposal.description: Offer an alternative. Sub-type determines what kind.

fields.modified_params: dict of param overrides if same_interaction_different_params
fields.invited_characters: list of char IDs if counter_type = invite_others

values.forced: Initiator acts unilaterally. Target has no advance consent. Used for: violence, theft, restraint, harassment, insults, CPR on unconscious, assault.
values.suggestion_proposal: Action is proposed to the target. Target may approve, reject, or counter-propose before anything happens.
values.if_reciprocated: Initiator expresses intent; action only executes if target also performs the matching action simultaneously (e.g. high-five, handshake, mutual dance start).
